en.content:
The correct order of the spin-only magnetic moments of the following complexes is :
(I) [Cr(H2O)6]Br2
(II) Na4[Fe(CN)6]
(III) Na3[Fe(C2O4)3] (0 P)
(IV) (Et4N)2[CoCl4]

options.content: (II) <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0.124ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.76ex" height="0.968ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -483 778 428" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mo"><use data-c="2248" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2248"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> (I) > (IV) > (III)

en.explanation:
(I) [Cr(H2O)6]Br2

H2O is weak field ligand so it can not pair up all the electrons.

Cr2+ : [Ar] 4s03d4 ()

Unpaired e– = 4

Magnetic moment = = 4.89 BM

(II) Na4[Fe(CN)6]

CN- is strong field ligand so it pair up all the electrons.

Fe2+ = [Ar] 4s03d6 ()

Unpaired e– = 0

Magnetic moment = 0 BM

(III) Na3[Fe(C2O4)3]

As 0 P, so pairing of electrons happens.

Fe3+ = [Ar] 4s03d5 ()

Unpaired e– = 1

Magnetic moment = = 1.73 BM

(IV) (Et4N)2[CoCl4]

Cl-is weak field ligand so it can not pair up all the electrons.

Co2+ = [Ar] 4s03d7 ()

Unpaired e– = 3

Magnetic moment = = 3.87 BM

Hence order of magnetic moment is
I > IV > III > II
